title: Saudi says Houthis targeted Mecca with a drone, Iran-backed group rejects claim
summary_full: The Organization of Islamic Cooperation condemned the strike as a "heinous" attack. Mecca is Islam's holiest site and the focal point of the annual Hajj pilgrimage.
